newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq closes lower, ends 11-day winning streak.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq closes lower, ends 11-day winning streak.

text.p: The Nasdaq Composite ended an 11-day winning streak to close lower on Monday as the resurgent high technologies came in for profit-taking.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was down 8.23 points, or 0.67 percent, at 1211.46 while declines led advances by 2178 to 1737 on volume of about 372 million shares.
"The tech sector had a terrific run over the last week and a half or so. There is a tendency to take profits on trading rallies," said Chris Callies, chief investment officer at CS First Boston.
She added that, "Sustainable leadership in the market is still large-cap oriented."
Among the over the counter high techs, Intel Corp was down 1-5/8 at 95-3/4 in active trading, while Dell Computer Corp was down 1-9/16 at 84-15/16 and Sun Microsystems Inc was down 1-3/8 at 60-3/8.
On the other hand, Iomega Corp was its usual volatile self, rising 15/16 to 18-13/16 to top the Nasdaq most active list.
